title: ad-hoc benchmarking cost sampler - customer trial grid (Jun 2026)
summary: Lightweight spreadsheet used to capture quick customer benchmark runs (latency / p95 / token-cost) and surface immediate cost-saving levers for sales/prod demos. Not exhaustive — designed for fast capture during trial and handoff to SEs.
goals: 1) Record a handful of representative trial runs per customer. 2) Attach a quick delta estimate for batching/quantization and prefix caching. 3) Flag experiments worth turning into a scoped Optimization ticket.
columns_description: Customer | Model | Sequence (avg) | Mode (sync/stream) | RPS observed | Latency p50/p95 | Token cost per req | Suggested quick lever | Est monthly delta | Owner | Notes
rows_sample: AcmePayments | redwood-7b-q4 | 256 | sync | 12 | 140ms / 420ms | $0.022 | enable batching (50ms tail) + prefix cache | -18% cost | Marcus Li | had 3 token-heavy prompts; client okay with 500ms p95 for batch window
row_2_sample: Shoply | open-13b-v2 | 1024 | stream | 3 | 320ms / 1.1s | $0.18 | q4 quant + lower beam | -25% cost | Sofia Alvarez | request: preserve deterministic outputs — avoid beam changes without eval
row_3_sample: EduNext | redwood-3b | 128 | sync | 45 | 90ms / 210ms | $0.006 | increase micro-batch to 8, enable KV prefix cache | -12% cost | Jonah Price | short convo flows; batching safe
notes_to_self:
- Use this sheet during trial calls; capture exact prompts if possible.
- If estimated delta > 20% create OPT ticket with prompt set and perf traces.
- Keep final handoff note: 'recommended config + expected cost change + risk summary'
open_questions:
- For streaming trials: should we measure token-level cost vs per-invocation cost? (Pros/cons noted below)
- How to represent burst allowance in monthlyized delta? (use 95th percentile traffic window)
- Need a canonical label set for Suggested quick lever to avoid free-text drift
quick_actions:
- Marcus: run 2 microbench runs for Acme with batching=50ms by EOD 6/18.
- Sofia: capture deterministic-eval on Shoply prompts and share results.
- Priya: file OPT-1427 if Shoply delta confirmed >20%
handoff_snippet: Handoff to SE/solutions: summary line, example prompts, perf traces link, recommended runtime knobs (batch/window/quant/profile id), expected monthly delta and known risks. Include contact (owner) and a 1-paragraph mitigation plan if output quality changes.
appendix_shortcuts:
- Perf traces: /observability/traces/customer/<id>
- Quant profiles: quant-profiles.redwood/internal/list
- Cost calc template: tinyurl.com/rdw-cost-calc (internal)
last_updated_context: Added Shoply stream run + initial quant delta estimate, flagged as in-review for optimization team. Small format tweak to include Owner column for faster triage.
